relationships.subject: abscisic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: Systemic or intrathecal administration of ABA ameliorates the development and pre-existence of mechanical allodynia and heat hyperalgesia in animals with partial sciatic nerve ligation (pSNL).

relationships.subject: abscisic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: Daily treatment of ABA significantly (n = 8, p < 0.001) attenuated the TNFα protein level in rats with pSNL

relationships.subject: abscisic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: systemic ABA treatment (20 mg/kg, i.p. for 10 days) significantly (p < 0.01) increased LANCL2 expression in the pSNL + ABA group

relationships.subject: LANCL2
relationships.evidence_quote: Spinal knockdown of LANCL2 gene with siRNA recapitulates the behavioral and spinal molecular changes induced by pSNL.

relationships.subject: abscisic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: Daily pre-emptive treatment of ABA (20 mg/kg, i.p.) to rats with pSNL significantly (n = 8, p < 0.05) reduced the elevated phosphorylated level of ERK in the spinal dorsal horn

key_findings: Spinal LANCL2 (microglia-only) is reduced after nerve injury; ABA restores LANCL2 and suppresses glial activation, ERK and TNFα, relieving neuropathic pain.
LANCL2 siRNA knockdown reproduces allodynia and molecular changes of pSNL.
